**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 1  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner made an error in reasoning by incorrectly concluding that the proton has the least mass instead of the electron. This mistake stems from a misinterpretation of factual data, specifically the relative masses of subatomic particles, where the electron is significantly lighter (approximately \(9.11 \times 10^{-31} \, \text{kg}\)) than the proton (\(1.67 \times 10^{-27} \, \text{kg}\)). The agent either confused the mass hierarchy or misapplied basic scientific knowledge about atomic structure. Furthermore, the Planner prematurely finalized the solution ("TASK_COMPLETE") without engaging other specialists (e.g., WebSurfer) to verify the reasoning or validate the answer. This reflects behaviors similar to **overconfidence in incorrect reasoning** and **failure to delegate for verification**, as seen in Example 1 and Example 2 of the reference cases.
